transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because… my mind keeps sort of going blank. At work, I’ll be looking at the road-closure forms, or holding the stop-slow paddle, and suddenly I can’t remember the steps. Things I’ve done for years. It’s been… hard to trust myself.
Do these blank moments seem to happen when you're under a lot of stress or pressure?
Yeah… I think so. It’s usually when I’m on the spot, like with the road-closure forms or holding the stop-slow paddle. My mind just blanks, and I can’t remember steps I’ve done for years.
Do these blank moments in your mind last for a while after the stressful situation has passed, or do they go away once the pressure is off?

It’s mostly right in the moment, when I’m under pressure. Like I’ll be staring at the forms or holding the paddle and… it’s just gone. I can’t remember the steps I know I know. I don’t really know how long after. It just shakes me up.
Do these memory blanks happen to you in situations outside of work as well?
Mostly I notice it at work. That’s where it scares me, with the forms or the stop-slow paddle… I just suddenly can’t remember steps I’ve done for years. Outside of work, I’m not sure.
Can you think of any situations outside of work where you've had trouble remembering something you normally know?

I… I can’t really think of many outside work. It’s mostly those work things that stick out, the road-closure forms or the paddle, where I suddenly can’t remember what I’m supposed to do. Outside of that, I’m not sure.
Do you often feel anxious or nervous in your daily life?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I get nervous when things are happening, but I don’t really keep track of it day to day.
Do you feel anxious or nervous most of the time?
I don’t know if I’d say most of the time. I mean… I get nervous, but I’m not sure it’s all the time.
Do you have trouble remembering things when you're relaxed and not under any pressure?

Mostly it seems to happen when I’m on the spot. Like at work, I’ll look at the forms or the stop-slow paddle and my mind just… goes blank, even though I’ve done those steps for years. When I’m relaxed, I’m not sure. I don’t notice it as much.
Do you have trouble remembering things when you are not under any pressure or stress?

I guess it’s mostly when there’s pressure. Like… I came in because my mind keeps going blank at bad times, with the road-closure forms or the stop-slow paddle. I’ll suddenly not remember steps I’ve done for years. When I’m not stressed, I don’t notice it as much.
Do you feel anxious when you're not at work and there's no immediate pressure or stress?
I’m not really sure. I mean… sometimes I feel uneasy, but I don’t always know if it’s anxiety or just me thinking too much. When there’s no pressure, I don’t notice it as clearly.
Do you ever have trouble remembering things when you are completely relaxed and there's no pressure on you?
I don’t really notice it when I’m completely relaxed. It’s more… at the worst times, like with the road-closure forms or the stop-slow paddle. I’ll just blank on steps I’ve done for years.
Do you have trouble remembering things from your past that happened before you started having these blank moments at work?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed that, not like… losing things from before. It’s more just the blanking when I’m trying to do something.
Do you have trouble remembering things that happened last week or last month?
Not really like last week or last month as a whole. It’s more when I’m right in front of something I should know—like the road-closure forms or the stop-slow paddle—and my mind just goes blank.
Do you ever feel like you're outside of your body or watching yourself when you have these blank moments?
I don’t think so. It’s more like I just… freeze up or blank out, not like I’m watching myself from somewhere else.
Do you ever feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings when you're not having one of these blank moments?
I don’t think so… not that I’ve noticed. I mean, I can feel kind of off sometimes, but not really disconnected like that.
Do you ever feel like you're in a daze or detached from what's happening around you?
Not really… I mean, I get kind of foggy sometimes, but I wouldn’t say detached. I’m still aware of what’s going on around me.
Do you ever feel like you're not yourself or like things aren't real when you're not having one of these blank moments?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t really felt like things aren’t real. Maybe just tired or foggy sometimes, but not that.
Have you experienced any traumatic events in your life that might be connected to when these blank moments started happening?
I… I’m not sure. I don’t really have anything like that I can point to. I haven’t connected it to some specific event.
Did your blank moments start happening after something significantly stressful or upsetting occurred in your life?
Yeah… I guess so. It started after my closest friend died. It’s been… about a year and eight months now.
